sloka: दृष्ट्वा ते राक्षसाः सर्वे मकराक्षस्य पातनम्।लङ्कामेवाभ्यधावन्त रामबाणार्दितास्तदा ।। ६.७९.३९ ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā te rākṣasāḥ sarve makarākṣasya pātanam।laṅkāmevābhyadhāvanta rāmabāṇārditāstadā ।। 6.79.39 ।।

translations.english: Then struck in the battlefield by that missile of Kakuthsa, the Rakshasa fell down with his heart split open and died.
